title.zh: Stripe计划年底前将稳定币卡业务扩展至100多个国家
title.en: Stripe to expand stablecoin cards to over 100 countries by the end of the year

current_state.zh:
Stripe计划在年底前将其稳定币卡项目扩展至100多个国家；被Stripe于2025年收购的钱包基础设施公司Privy的CEO兼联合创始人Henri Stern新增一职，负责Stripe整体的稳定币与加密业务。据Paymentscan数据，上月通过卡片消费的稳定币约为12亿美元，是一年前的三倍。

稳定币卡是规模超过3000亿美元的数字美元市场中增长迅速的一块，而文中引用的交易量数据表明，稳定币正从加密交易和跨境转账延伸至日常消费场景。Stripe稳定币卡项目的现有客户包括加密交易所Kraken、金融科技公司Ramp和支付应用Morse。

Stern表示该扩展预计在年底前完成，并称Stripe打算保持“完全对稳定币中立、完全对区块链中立”，目前许多项目使用的是Circle的USDC。Stripe称自2018年以来已发行超过4亿张卡、处理了数千亿美元的卡交易额，其稳定币业务将这一发卡业务与2024年以11亿美元收购的稳定币基础设施公司Bridge结合起来；Stripe还在探索代币化存款和DeFi应用场景。
current_state.en: Stripe is expanding its stablecoin card programs to more than 100 countries by the end of the year, appointing Privy CEO Henri Stern to oversee stablecoins and crypto, as stablecoin card spending tripled to roughly $1.2 billion last month.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Stripe is expanding its stablecoin card programs to more than 100 countries by the end of the year, appointing Privy CEO Henri Stern to oversee stablecoins and crypto, as stablecoin card spending tripled to roughly $1.2 billion last month.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Stripe is expanding its stablecoin card programs to more than 100 countries by the end of the year, appointing Privy CEO Henri Stern to oversee stablecoins and crypto, as stablecoin card spending tripled to roughly $1.2 billion last month.
updates.background_zh: Stripe已为更大范围的区块链支付布局拼齐拼图：在收购Bridge和Privy之后，它与加密投资公司Paradigm合作开发区块链支付网络Tempo，并作为创始投资方参与了Open Standard——该公司正在开发旨在挑战Circle的USDC与Tether的USDT的稳定币Open USD。Bridge联合创始人Zach Abrams最近全职负责Open Standard。Stripe据悉正在探索的代币化存款，是由商业银行在区块链上发行的传统银行存款的数字表示，在结构上与非银行机构发行的稳定币不同。
updates.background_en: Stripe has assembled a broader blockchain payments push: after acquiring Bridge and Privy, it partnered with crypto investment firm Paradigm to develop Tempo, a blockchain designed for payments, and is a founding investor in Open Standard, the company developing Open USD, a stablecoin aimed at challenging Circle's USDC and Tether's USDT. Bridge co-founder Zach Abrams recently moved to run Open Standard full time. Tokenized deposits, which Stripe is said to be exploring, are blockchain-based digital representations of conventional bank deposits issued by commercial banks, structurally distinct from stablecoins issued by non-bank entities.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该计划主要通过稳定币的支付用途和卡消费需求传导至加密市场：Stripe的稳定币卡目前大多运行在Circle的USDC之上，因此多国扩张以及Stripe对Open USD的支持会牵动稳定币的流通与结算需求，也涉及承接链上支付流的卡组织与钱包基础设施合作方。文中提到的每月约12亿美元稳定币卡消费，在全球卡支付市场中仍只占很小一部分，这限制了该渠道近期的规模。
updates.market_impact_en: The plan transmits to crypto markets mainly through stablecoin payment utility and card-spend demand: Stripe's stablecoin cards currently run largely on Circle's USDC, so a multi-country rollout and Stripe's backing of Open USD touch stablecoin circulation and settlement demand, as well as card-network and wallet-infrastructure partners exposed to on-chain payment flows. The cited $1.2 billion in monthly stablecoin card spend remains a fraction of the global card payments market, which bounds the near-term scale of that channel.
